column1: # Required checks per repo: the merge gate when GitHub cannot be (harbor#1060).
# repo<TAB>check name, exactly as `gh pr checks` prints it. bin/gate-merge-check.sh reads it.
# harbor and the two public repos: the live branch-protection contexts, 2026-10-05. harbor is gated by `public-ci` alone
# since 2026-10-20: its suites run on hosted CI in harbor-core, so the self-hosted Mac pool carries none of harbor's gate.
# Every other repo's rows (the operator's private repos, another org's) are the private layer's required-checks.tsv
# (contracts/private-layer.md); bin/gate-required-generate.sh appends them for the readers.
# harbor-core: its export PRs are merged by hand, and its ruleset requires no check (2026-11-04, operator decision on harbor-core#88).
# Only jobs that run on every PR: stranger-install is path-filtered and `generated status is current` skips at level quick.
